reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: After freezing, started again from the exact dated UvA catalogue groups, course descriptions and the workbook. Checked the listed credits and entry rules, independent thesis anchor and actual overlap before comparing the results with the canonical.
findings: The 2026–2027 course catalogue verifies a single 180 EC degree with Dutch and English teaching variants of equal academic content. Year one has ten compulsory 6 EC units. Year two has nine compulsory 6 EC units plus one 6 EC choice. Innovation Management in an International Context is selected on academic continuity, with Finance 2 left unselected. Year three reserves 30 EC for a minor, exchange, electives or a 12 EC internship with 18 EC electives, then one 30 EC specialisation. The dated catalogue lists Management in the Digital Age while the current study page calls it The Future of Management and AI. The dated catalogue controls exact course titles and verifies four 6 EC specialisation units and a separate 6 EC thesis and seminar. No other route or alternative component is counted.

The normal sequence completes 60 EC before year two and 120 EC before year three, satisfying the thesis’s current 90 EC pre-year and 120 EC course-start thresholds. The current course catalogue requires Strategy and Organisation for Innovation Management, Project Entrepreneurship, Strategy and Change and International Management. Marketing precedes Digital Technologies and Marketing, and Organisational Behaviour precedes Management and Leadership in the Digital Age. The first quantitative course precedes the second and the second-year quantitative project. The catalogue’s 10 hours of programme research participation are an additional requirement before passing the thesis, outside the 180 EC. The prior regulations corroborate the normal 48 EC binding-study-advice rule. The proposed year one completes all 60 EC.

The four named specialisation courses total 24 EC and the thesis is separately 6 EC. Public marketing language about the route does not overwrite the title in the applicable catalogue. UCR accounting teaches statements, costing and budgeting, and the dedicated UvA finance course shares asset valuation with UCR Money, Banking & Finance. UvA Information and Data Management shares the business effects of digital technology with UCR AI study, with data management also present in UvA. Database work supplies a useful standalone method without constituting operations management. Rechecked option feasibility, distinctness and the 15 EC optional UCR research element outside all three schedules.

The closest option progresses through business foundations, economics and research methods to strategic choices, marketing, product development and market research. The workbook provides actual venture models, financial statements, global market-entry analysis, organisational psychology and AI cases. The sustainability option uses the same business foundations, then life-cycle assessment, circular processes, sustainable farming, governance, energy and company-facing renewable design. Product Design supplies customer research, costing, resource use and repairability, so contributes to sustainable operations as well as ventures. Sustainability Essentials II is primarily physical science and measurement for environmental technologies. The finance option anchors accounting in costing, budgeting and investment appraisal, and develops financial markets, bank capital, liquidity and risk. Quantitative methods include regression, predictive validation, probability, optimisation and numerical methods. The description-only Econometrics, Behavioral Economics, Market Research, Strategy & Digital Transformation, Database Management Systems and Renewable System Design have substantive roles within the limits of their stated material. General analytics are not specialised corporate valuation or portfolio training. The digital candidate would duplicate strategy and AI study or overlap the third option’s analytics. The broad option owns venture and creative innovation through actual business models and prototyping. The corrected alignment pairs cross-border management to International Business rather than law, pairs legal subject matter separately, and leaves dedicated operations and the thesis unmatched. Dedicated management accounting overlaps with costing and budgets in UCR’s combined accounting course, counted only once. The 6 EC required thesis is distinct from optional UCR research.
